**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching restriction binding Meridian. Searches across "solicit", "hire", "induce", "employ", and "recruit" surfaced only:

- **§ 12.3** — affirmatively preserves our freedom to hire any person responding to general recruitment and records that Customer "has made no ... no-hire commitment."
- **§ 30.1** — a standard independent-contractor clause allocating personnel compensation/tax responsibility to Vendor, with no hiring restriction.

This sits at the **preferred** position (no non-solicit on Customer) rather than the fallback, and § 12.3 operates in our favour, so it should not be flagged or amended.
